name: tracker-item-journal
goal: Apply Tracker item operations to existing SQLite stores with exactly-once op IDs, per-field clock merges, append-only notes, and atomic commit.

evidence: Tracker 122e190 store provides the compatibility contract. Prove out-of-order field merges, duplicate op IDs, forward-compatible unknown fields, append-only notes, and rollback of an invalid batch on a synthetic SQLite fixture.

Ported the existing operation envelope and durable projection semantics into a driver-injected Harness repository. The duplicate check precedes INSERT under the write lock to preserve SQLite AUTOINCREMENT cursor values.

Three initially failing cases at f5feb238f5 now pass. The reconnect assertion additionally caught duplicate retry advancing sqlite_sequence from 2 to 5 and passes with the insert guard. On harbor-mbp-2, the real 122e190 store and candidate produced equal synthetic ops, item rows, notes, coupled receipt and sequence rows, and returned integrity_check=ok.
